description: This file defines an interface 'IProxyGrain' in the 'UnitTests.GrainInterfaces' namespace, which declares asynchronous methods related to proxy management and runtime identification.

classes.name: IProxyGrain
classes.description: An interface extending 'IGrainWithIntegerKey' that declares methods for creating proxies and retrieving runtime IDs.

methods.name: CreateProxy
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a proxy with the specified key.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the runtime instance ID as a string.

methods.name: GetProxyRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the proxy's runtime instance ID as a string.
